about_short_description.short_description: Polished is a dental care center that offers dental hygiene examinations, dental sealants, and oral prophylaxis services.

product.name: Dental Hygiene Examination
product.description: A professional assessment of oral health to identify dental issues and recommend appropriate care.

product.name: Oral Prophylaxis (Teeth Cleaning)
product.description: A dental cleaning procedure that removes plaque, tartar, and stains from teeth to maintain oral hygiene.

product.name: Dental Sealants
product.description: A protective coating applied to teeth to prevent decay, especially on molars and premolars.

product.name: Fluoride Application
product.description: A treatment applying fluoride to teeth to strengthen enamel and reduce the risk of cavities.

product.name: Individualized, Patient-Centered Oral Health Education
product.description: Personalized education on oral hygiene practices tailored to individual patient needs.
